sources.title: How to Implement a Q-Learning Agent in FrozenLake-v1 (No Slippery)
sources.snippet: Understanding FrozenLake-v1 Imagine a frosty lake where a little agent (like our Q-learning model) must navigate to reach a goal without falling into holes. In the FrozenLake-v1 environment, our agent receives rewards for successfully traversing from the start to the goal while avoiding pitfalls.
